say:1:1122111001:1.text: Pshaw. You're stumped by just a few terrabirds?
say:1:1122111001:1.source_cn: 区区几只陆行鸟，就把你难住了？
say:1:1122111001:1.male: Pshaw. You're stumped by just a few terrabirds?
say:1:1122111001:1.female: Pshaw. You're stumped by just a few terrabirds?

say:2:1122111002:1.text: Lesson number one of being a bounty hunter! Efficiency above all else! Time is precious, after all.
say:2:1122111002:1.source_cn: 赏金猎人的第一课——效率至上！不要把时间浪费在毫无意义...

say:3:1122111003:1.text: Times like this, you gotta think about what tools can help you. Traps, for example.
say:3:1122111003:1.source_cn: 像现在这种情况，你应该想想有没有什么辅助道具可以用。比...
say:3:1122111003:1.male: Times like this, you gotta think about what tools can help you. Traps, for example.
say:3:1122111003:1.female: Times like this, you gotta think about what tools can help you. Traps, for example.

say:5:1122111004:1.text: Duh, you're stating the obvious! But these terrabirds are still babies, regular traps could hurt them!
say:5:1122111004:1.source_cn: 我们当然知道要用陷阱！但这里的陆行鸟都是幼鸟，随随便便...

say:6:1122111005:1.text: Well, that just means you picked the wrong tools!
say:6:1122111005:1.source_cn: 哼，那只能说明，你们挑选的道具不对。

say:7:1122111006:1.text: The right tools can make your job twice as easy, while the wrong tools will just make you look silly.
say:7:1122111006:1.source_cn: 合适的道具可以让行动事半功倍，不合适的道具却只会弄巧成拙。

say:9:1122111007:1.text: Do you have a trap that can catch terrabirds without hurting them?
say:9:1122111007:1.source_cn: 难道你有既能抓住陆行鸟，又不伤害它们的陷阱吗？

say:10:1122111008:1.text: Have you even seen me?! Of course I'm always prepared for any situation!

say:11:1122111009:1.text: There's a fair bit of <style="highlight">tumbleweed</style> in the Eroded Enclave. This plant is sturdy and would make a trap that isn't harmful to small animals.

choice_prompt:12:1122111009.text: There's a fair bit of <style="highlight">tumbleweed</style> in the Eroded Enclave. This plant is sturdy and would make a trap that isn't harmful to small animals.
choice_prompt:12:1122111009.source_cn: 风蚀飞地上经常出现<style=highlight>风滚草</style>。这种植物韧性很强，也没什么杀伤力，最适合制作动物捕捉的陷阱。

say:13:1122111010:1.text: Ha! It's about time you finally appreciate my wisdom.
say:13:1122111010:1.source_cn: 看来你已经领悟到这节课的精髓了。
say:13:1122111010:1.male: Ha! It's about time you finally appreciate my wisdom.
say:13:1122111010:1.female: Ha! It's about time you finally appreciate my wisdom.

say:14:1122111012:1.text: Now go gather some <style="highlight">tumbleweed</style>. Leave the trap-making to me.
say:14:1122111012:1.source_cn: 接下来就去收集<style=highlight>风滚草...

say:16:1122111011:1.text: Well aren't you a confident one? Still, it's about time you appreciate my wisdom.
say:16:1122111011:1.source_cn: 看你胸有成竹的样子，我就已经猜到了。

say:16:1122111011:1.female: Well aren't you a confident one? Still, it's about time you appreciate my wisdom.
